hero.subtitle: Siedu is an integrated tutoring system for one institution. Enrollment, payments, attendance, and grading from TK through SMA all run in one place, not across a dozen chats.
hero.photoAlt: Illustration of a child learning at Siedu

proof.quota: Seats lock the moment you enroll
proof.attendance: Today's attendance is visible right away

quote.text: A child's learning progress should be something you can open, check, and hold accountable. Not something you chase through chats that sometimes get answered, sometimes don't.
quote.caption: The promise behind every feature in Siedu.

story.p1: Not because the lessons were bad. Because the information was scattered. Enrollment by chat, payment by bank transfer, progress never reported. Many parents stop following up in the end, not out of indifference, but because they're tired of asking.
story.p2: Siedu rebuilds that flow. Every trace of your child's course is recorded in one system the institution actually uses, and you can open it any time.

problems.title: Recognize any of these?
problems.bridge: At Siedu, all four have an answer in the system:
items: Enrolling by chat, answered whenever the teacher gets a moment
Paying by transfer, receipts piling up in your phone gallery
Never knowing whether your child showed up
Grades only appearing at the end of the semester, if at all
Pick a class and the seat locks through the platform, not by waiting for a chat reply.
Payments go through Midtrans, recorded in full or as an installment plan.
Teachers enter attendance every session, and you can check it the same day.
Grades go into your child's portfolio with a traceable history.

values.lead: Not slogans on a wall. Each one has a technical consequence in the system.

hero.title: Transparent about cost
hero.body: Class fees are shown in full from the start, with no hidden line items. Payment history and outstanding balances stay tidy in the parent portal.
hero.footnote: The first reason Siedu was built.

items.title: Children's privacy first
items.body: One system for one institution. Student data is never mixed with other parties, and parental consent is requested up front.

items.title: Rules that get honored
items.body: Seats lock at enrollment, the payment window is 7 working days, grade corrections go through the official flow. Written down, not decided on the spot.

items.title: Evidence, not gut feel
items.body: Attendance and grades are entered by teachers and immediately visible to parents. Progress can be checked any time, instead of chased through chat.

mission.vision: Quality education that every parent can follow: your child's learning process recorded neatly, openly, and accountably, from TK through SMA.
mission.visionNote: This vision is carried out as written system rules on the terms page, not left as a spoken promise.
missionItems: Bring enrollment, payment, attendance, and grading together in one system the institution uses.
Show class costs in full from the start, including DP and installment options through Midtrans.
Lock class seats at enrollment so no double promises happen.
Report attendance and grades through teacher input at every session.
Keep one institution's student data its own: never mixed with other parties, with parental consent obtained first.
